definition_en: to take hold of something suddenly, or to take an opportunity quickly
core_image: 一只手猛地伸出，在栏杆滑落前牢牢握住它
scene: 他一把抓住栏杆。He grabbed the railing.
sceneCN: 这里 grab 是「抓住」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他一把抓住栏杆。

senses.title: To seize suddenly
senses.definition: to take hold of something quickly and roughly
senses.definitionCN: 迅速而粗暴地握住某物
senses.example: He grabbed the railing.
senses.exampleCN: 他一把抓住栏杆。
senses.why: This is the basic physical sense of a sudden grasp.
senses.whyCN: 这是突然抓握的基本物理含义。

senses.title: To take a chance
senses.definition: to take an opportunity quickly before it is lost
senses.definitionCN: 在机会失去之前迅速把握
senses.example: She grabbed the chance to study abroad.
senses.exampleCN: 她抓住了出国留学的机会。
senses.why: An opportunity is treated like an object that can slip away.
senses.whyCN: 机会被当作可能滑走的物体来对待。

senses.title: A quick snatch
senses.definition: a sudden act of taking hold of something
senses.definitionCN: 突然握住某物的动作
senses.example: He made a grab for the falling cup.
senses.exampleCN: 他伸手去抓掉落的杯子。
senses.why: The noun keeps the suddenness of the verb.
senses.whyCN: 名词保留了动词的突然性。

intro.en: Grab came into English from Low German and Dutch words for seizing.
intro.cn: grab 从低地德语和荷兰语中表示抓取的词进入英语。

items.en: Grabben meant to seize or snatch.
items.cn: grabben 意为抓住或抢夺。

items.en: Grabben carried the same grasping sense.
items.cn: grabben 带有同样的抓握含义。

items.en: Grab entered English in the sixteenth century.
items.cn: grab 于十六世纪进入英语。

items.en: It spread from hands to chances and attention.
items.cn: 它从手部动作扩展到机会和注意力。

items.en: Up for grabs meant open to anyone.
items.cn: up for grabs 表示任何人都可以争取。

note.en: Grab is compared with look-alike words and verbs of seizing.
note.cn: 把 grab 与形近词以及表示抓取的动词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Grab is the hand closing before the mind has time to think.
normalIntro.cn: grab 是脑子还没想，手已经合拢。

normal.en: He grabbed the railing.
She grabbed the chance to study abroad.
normal.cn: 她抓住了出国留学的机会。

normal.en: He made a grab for the falling cup.
normal.cn: 他伸手去抓掉落的杯子。

normal.en: Let's grab a bite before the film.
normal.cn: 看电影前我们随便吃点东西吧。

normal.en: The last ticket is up for grabs.

abstract.en: Chances pass at the speed of hands.
abstract.cn: 机会以双手的速度经过。

abstract.en: What is grabbed in haste is often dropped in haste.
abstract.cn: 仓促抓来的，往往仓促丢下。

abstract.en: Attention is the one thing no hand can hold.
abstract.cn: 注意力是双手唯一握不住的东西。

examples.en: He grabbed the railing.
examples.cn: 他一把抓住栏杆。

examples.en: She grabbed the chance to study abroad.
examples.cn: 她抓住了出国留学的机会。

examples.en: He made a grab for the falling cup.
examples.cn: 他伸手去抓掉落的杯子。

dict_mnemonic.text: grab 表示「猛地抓住」，可指抓东西、抓住机会，也可作名词表示「抓取」；grab attention 是「吸引注意」，grab a bite 是「随便吃点」，up for grabs 是「人人可争」。

root: 来自低地德语和荷兰语 grabben（抓取），十六世纪进入英语，核心义为迅速而有力地握住，后扩展到抓住机会、吸引注意等抽象用法。

sensesIntro.en: Grab means to seize something suddenly, to take an opportunity, or a quick act of seizing.
sensesIntro.cn: grab 指突然抓住某物、把握机会，或突然抓取的动作。

core.en: A hand closing fast on a thing.
core.cn: 迅速合拢在事物上的手。

branches.en: Fingers lock around a sliding rail.
branches.cn: 手指扣住正在滑落的栏杆。

branches.en: A door opens for a second and is taken.
branches.cn: 一扇门开了一瞬，随即被把握。

branches.en: A cup falls and a hand darts out.
branches.cn: 杯子落下，一只手猛地伸出。

branches.en: The verb and the noun both live in one instant.
branches.cn: 动词与名词都活在同一瞬间。

branches.en: A rail and a chance are both caught before they slip.
branches.cn: 栏杆与机会，都要在滑走前抓住。

intro.en: Grab forms agents, adjectives, and informal compounds.
intro.cn: grab 构成施事名词、形容词和口语复合词。

latinIntro.en: Grab is Germanic and has no Latin root.
latinIntro.cn: grab 属日耳曼语，没有拉丁词根。

items.example: He grabs his coat and runs.
She grabbed the chance to study abroad.
items.exampleCN: 她抓住了出国留学的机会。

items.example: He was grabbing at the rope.

items.meaning: a device or person that grabs
items.example: The robot has a metal grabber.
items.exampleCN: 机器人有一个金属抓取器。

items.example: The child was grabby with toys.

items.exampleCN: 这家店卖即取即走的餐食。

definition_en: smooth and elegant movement, undeserved favour, or extra time allowed for a duty
core_image: 舞者踮起脚尖，裙摆划出一道平滑的弧线，毫无迟滞
scene: 她跳舞时带着一种自然的优雅。She dances with natural grace.
sceneCN: 这里 grace 是「优雅」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她跳舞时带着一种自然的优雅。

senses.title: Elegant movement
senses.definition: smoothness and ease of movement or manner
senses.definitionCN: 动作或举止的平滑与从容
senses.example: She dances with natural grace.
senses.exampleCN: 她跳舞时带着一种自然的优雅。
senses.why: This is the sense of effortless beauty in motion.
senses.whyCN: 这是动作中毫不费力的美的含义。

senses.title: Undeserved favour
senses.definition: kindness or favour freely given
senses.definitionCN: 无偿给予的善意或恩惠
senses.example: By the grace of God, they survived the storm.
senses.exampleCN: 承蒙天恩，他们从风暴中活了下来。
senses.why: Grace first named a gift freely given, often from a higher power.
senses.whyCN: grace 最初指无偿给予的恩赐，常来自更高的力量。

senses.title: Extra time allowed
senses.definition: extra time given to do something before a penalty
senses.definitionCN: 在受罚前额外给予的完成时间
senses.example: The bank gave them a month's grace.
senses.exampleCN: 银行给了他们一个月的宽限。
senses.why: Favour in time became a legal and financial grace period.
senses.whyCN: 时间上的恩惠变成了法律和金融上的宽限期。

intro.en: Grace came from Latin gratia, favour or thanks.
intro.cn: grace 来自拉丁语 gratia，意为恩惠或感谢。

items.en: Gratia meant favour, thanks, or goodwill.
items.cn: gratia 意为恩惠、感谢或好意。

items.en: Grace named a gift or a pleasing manner.
items.cn: grace 指恩赐或讨人喜欢的举止。

items.en: Grace entered English with both senses.
items.cn: grace 带着这两层含义进入英语。

items.en: It came to describe smooth beauty of movement.
items.cn: 它逐渐用来描述动作的流畅之美。

items.en: It also gave the grace period of a debt.
items.cn: 它还产生了债务的宽限期之意。

note.en: Grace is compared with look-alike words and words for elegance.
note.cn: 把 grace 与形近词以及表示优雅的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Grace is beauty without effort and kindness without debt.
normalIntro.cn: grace 是不费力的美，是不欠债的善。

normal.en: She dances with natural grace.
normal.cn: 她跳舞时带着一种自然的优雅。

normal.en: By the grace of God, they survived the storm.
normal.cn: 承蒙天恩，他们从风暴中活了下来。

normal.en: The bank gave them a month's grace.
normal.cn: 银行给了他们一个月的宽限。

normal.en: He accepted the defeat with grace.
The old church has a simple grace.
normal.cn: 那座老教堂有一种朴素的优雅。

abstract.en: Grace is strength that has stopped straining.
abstract.cn: 优雅，是停止用力的力量。

abstract.en: A gift freely given leaves no chain behind.
abstract.cn: 无偿的恩赐不留锁链。

abstract.en: Time granted in mercy is time bought back.
abstract.cn: 仁慈给予的时间，是被赎回的时间。

examples.en: She dances with natural grace.
examples.cn: 她跳舞时带着一种自然的优雅。

examples.en: By the grace of God, they survived the storm.
examples.cn: 承蒙天恩，他们从风暴中活了下来。

examples.en: The bank gave them a month's grace.
examples.cn: 银行给了他们一个月的宽限。

dict_mnemonic.text: grace 源自拉丁语 gratia（恩惠、感谢），既可指「优雅」，也可指「恩惠」与「宽限期」；graceful 是「优雅的」，gracious 是「亲切的」，grace period 是「宽限期」。

root: 来自拉丁语 gratia（恩惠、感谢），源于 gratus（令人愉快的、感激的），经古法语进入英语，核心义为他人的好意，以及由此流露的从容优美。

sensesIntro.en: Grace means elegant ease, freely given favour, or extra time allowed.
sensesIntro.cn: grace 指优雅从容、无偿给予的恩惠，或被允许的额外时间。

core.en: Favour shown in beauty or in mercy.
core.cn: 以优美或仁慈显出的好意。

branches.en: A dancer crosses the stage without effort.
branches.cn: 舞者毫不费力地穿过舞台。

branches.en: A gift arrives from nowhere and is received.
branches.cn: 一份恩赐不知从何而来，被人领受。

branches.en: A debt waits one more month.
branches.cn: 一笔债务又等了一个月。

branches.en: Ease of body and kindness of heart both come as gifts.
branches.cn: 身体的从容与内心的善意，都像礼物。

branches.en: Favour in life and favour in time share one name.
branches.cn: 生命中的恩惠与时间上的恩惠共用一个名字。

intro.en: Grace forms adjectives of elegance and of kindness.
intro.cn: grace 构成表示优雅和善意的形容词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root is gratia, favour, from gratus, pleasing or thankful.
latinIntro.cn: 其拉丁词根是 gratia（恩惠），源于 gratus（令人愉快的、感激的）。

definition_en: moving or shaped with smooth beauty, or behaving in a polite and dignified way
core_image: 天鹅在水面上滑行，长颈弯成一道平滑的弧线
scene: 天鹅在水面上划出优美的弧线。The swan made a graceful curve on the water.
sceneCN: 这里 graceful 是「优美的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：天鹅在水面上划出优美的弧线。

senses.title: Beautiful in movement
senses.definition: moving in a smooth and attractive way
senses.definitionCN: 以平滑而悦目的方式移动
senses.example: The swan made a graceful curve on the water.
senses.exampleCN: 天鹅在水面上划出优美的弧线。
senses.why: This is the central sense of pleasing motion.
senses.whyCN: 这是表示动作悦目的核心含义。

senses.title: Dignified in conduct
senses.definition: behaving in a polite and dignified way, especially in difficulty
senses.definitionCN: 尤其在困境中举止礼貌而有尊严
senses.example: She made a graceful exit from the meeting.
senses.exampleCN: 她体面地退出了会议。
senses.why: The beauty of movement became a beauty of manners.
senses.whyCN: 动作之美延伸为举止之美。

senses.title: Smooth in line
senses.definition: having a smooth and pleasing shape or line
senses.definitionCN: 具有平滑悦目的形状或线条
senses.example: The bridge has a graceful line.
senses.exampleCN: 这座桥的线条很流畅。
senses.why: Shape borrowed the same word as movement.
senses.whyCN: 形状借用了与动作相同的词。

intro.en: Graceful is grace with the Old English ending -ful, full of grace.
intro.cn: graceful 是 grace 加古英语词尾 -ful，意为充满优雅。

items.en: Gratia meant favour and pleasing quality.
items.cn: gratia 意为恩惠与令人愉快的品质。

items.en: Grace named a pleasing manner.
items.cn: grace 指讨人喜欢的举止。

items.en: Grace entered English as elegance and favour.
items.cn: grace 以优雅和恩惠之义进入英语。

items.en: Graceful was formed to mean full of grace.
items.cn: graceful 被构造成「充满优雅」之意。

items.en: It spread from bodies to lines and manners.
items.cn: 它从身体扩展到线条和举止。

note.en: Graceful is compared with look-alike words and words for elegance.
note.cn: 把 graceful 与形近词以及表示优雅的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Graceful is what grace looks like when it moves.
normalIntro.cn: graceful 是优雅动起来的样子。

normal.en: The swan made a graceful curve on the water.
normal.cn: 天鹅在水面上划出优美的弧线。

normal.en: She made a graceful exit from the meeting.
The bridge has a graceful line.
The dancer's movements were graceful.
He offered a graceful apology.

abstract.en: Graceful is effort that has learned to hide.
abstract.cn: 优美，是学会了隐藏的用力。

abstract.en: A graceful exit says more than a loud entrance.
abstract.cn: 体面的退场胜过喧闹的登场。

abstract.en: Line and limb obey the same quiet law.
abstract.cn: 线条与肢体遵循同一条安静的法则。

examples.en: The swan made a graceful curve on the water.
examples.cn: 天鹅在水面上划出优美的弧线。

examples.en: The bridge has a graceful line.
examples.cn: 这座桥的线条很流畅。

dict_mnemonic.text: graceful 由 grace（优雅）加形容词词尾 -ful 构成，表示「优美的、得体的」；gracefully 是「优雅地」，gracefulness 是「优雅」，注意与 grateful（感激的）区分。

root: 由 grace（源自拉丁语 gratia，恩惠、优雅）加古英语形容词词尾 -ful 构成，本义为充满优雅的，引申为动作优美、举止得体、线条流畅。

sensesIntro.en: Graceful means beautiful in movement, dignified in conduct, or smooth in shape.
sensesIntro.cn: graceful 指动作优美、举止得体，或形状线条流畅。

core.en: Ease made visible.
core.cn: 变得可见的从容。

branches.en: A swan draws a curve across still water.
branches.cn: 天鹅在静水上画出一道弧线。

branches.en: A person leaves a meeting with dignity.
branches.cn: 一个人带着尊严离开会议。

branches.en: A bridge arcs without a single sharp turn.
branches.cn: 一座桥弯成弧线，没有一处尖角。

branches.en: Movement and line share the same smooth law.
branches.cn: 动作与线条共享同一条平滑法则。

branches.en: Beauty of body and beauty of manner meet in one word.
branches.cn: 身体之美与举止之美在一个词里相遇。

intro.en: Graceful forms adverbs and nouns of elegance.
intro.cn: graceful 构成表示优雅的副词和名词。

latinIntro.cn: 其拉丁词根是 gratia（恩惠），源于 gratus（令人愉快的）。

definition_en: to finish a course of study, to award a degree, or a person who has finished study
core_image: 身着学位袍的年轻人把帽子抛向空中，纸屑在礼堂灯光下飘落
scene: 她去年大学毕业。She graduated from college last year.
sceneCN: 这里 graduate 是「毕业」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她去年大学毕业。

senses.title: To finish study
senses.definition: to complete a course of study at a school or university
senses.definitionCN: 完成学校或大学的学业
senses.example: She graduated from college last year.
senses.exampleCN: 她去年大学毕业。
senses.why: This is the central modern sense of completing a degree.
senses.whyCN: 这是现代表示完成学位的核心含义。

senses.title: To award a degree
senses.definition: to give a degree to a student who has finished study
senses.definitionCN: 向完成学业的学生授予学位
senses.example: The university graduated two thousand students.
senses.exampleCN: 这所大学让两千名学生毕业。
senses.why: The school side of the same act is also called graduate.
senses.whyCN: 同一行为的学校一方，也用 graduate 表示。

senses.title: A finished student
senses.definition: a person who has completed a course of study
senses.definitionCN: 完成某一学业的人
senses.example: She is a graduate of Yale.
senses.exampleCN: 她是耶鲁大学的毕业生。
senses.why: The noun names the person who has reached the final step.
senses.whyCN: 名词指走到最后一级台阶的人。

intro.en: Graduate came from medieval Latin graduari, to take a degree, from gradus, a step.
intro.cn: graduate 来自中世纪拉丁语 graduari（取得学位），源于 gradus（台阶）。

items.en: Gradus meant a step or a rank.
items.cn: gradus 意为台阶或等级。

items.en: Graduari meant to take a degree by steps.
items.cn: graduari 意为一级一级取得学位。

items.en: Graduate entered English as a word of the university.
items.cn: graduate 作为大学用语进入英语。

items.en: It named both the act and the person.
items.cn: 它同时指毕业的行为和毕业的人。

items.en: Graduate school extended it to advanced study.
items.cn: graduate school 把它扩展到研究生阶段。

note.en: Graduate is compared with look-alike words and words for students.
note.cn: 把 graduate 与形近词以及表示学生的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: To graduate is to climb the last step of a course and step off.
normalIntro.cn: graduate 就是爬完课程的最后一级台阶，迈出去。

normal.en: She graduated from college last year.
The university graduated two thousand students.
normal.cn: 这所大学让两千名学生毕业。

normal.en: She is a graduate of Yale.
normal.cn: 她是耶鲁大学的毕业生。

normal.en: He is studying at graduate school.
She graduated with honours in physics.
normal.cn: 她以优异成绩毕业于物理专业。

abstract.en: A degree is a step, not a summit.
abstract.cn: 学位是一级台阶，不是顶峰。

abstract.en: Graduation ends a course but not the learning.
abstract.cn: 毕业结束一段课程，却不结束学习。

abstract.en: Every graduate carries a door that only opens forward.
abstract.cn: 每个毕业生都带着一扇只能向前开的门。

examples.cn: 她去年大学毕业。

examples.cn: 这所大学让两千名学生毕业。

examples.en: She is a graduate of Yale.
examples.cn: 她是耶鲁大学的毕业生。

dict_mnemonic.text: graduate 源自拉丁语 gradus（台阶），指走完学业台阶，即「毕业」，也可指「授予学位」和「毕业生」；graduation 是「毕业典礼」，undergraduate 是「本科生」，postgraduate 是「研究生」。

root: 来自中世纪拉丁语 graduari（取得学位），源于拉丁语 gradus（台阶），核心义为一级一级走完学业、取得学位。

sensesIntro.cn: graduate 指完成学业、授予学位，或完成学业的人。

core.en: Stepping off the last stair of a course.
core.cn: 走下一段学业的最后一级台阶。

branches.en: A student walks out of the gate with a diploma.
branches.cn: 一名学生拿着文凭走出校门。

branches.en: A university hands degrees to a long line.
branches.cn: 大学向长长的队伍颁发学位。

branches.en: An old student returns to visit the campus.
branches.cn: 一位老学生回校访问。

branches.en: The act and the person are two sides of one ending.
branches.cn: 行为与人是同一个结束的两面。

branches.en: Awarding and receiving a degree complete one step.
branches.cn: 授予与获得学位，共同完成一级台阶。

intro.en: Graduate forms nouns for stages of study.
intro.cn: graduate 构成表示学业阶段的名词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root is graduari, to take a degree, from gradus, a step.
latinIntro.cn: 其拉丁词根是 graduari（取得学位），源于 gradus（台阶）。

items.en: Grain named grain and the seed of plants.

definition_en: the rules for how words are used and put together in a language, or a book about them
core_image: 一本翻开的语法书，书页上标着句子成分的连线与箭头
scene: 英语语法有许多例外。English grammar has many exceptions.

senses.title: The rules of a language
senses.definition: the system of rules for forming words and sentences
senses.definitionCN: 构成词和句子的规则体系
senses.example: English grammar has many exceptions.
senses.exampleCN: 英语语法有许多例外。
senses.why: This is the central sense of the whole system.

senses.title: Coarse-grained intrusive igneous rock
senses.definition: an igneous rock that cooled slowly deep underground, allowing large crystals of quartz, feldspar, and mica to grow
senses.definitionCN: 在地下深处缓慢冷却、因而长出大颗石英、长石与云母晶体的火成岩
senses.example: The sea cliff is solid granite speckled with dark and pale crystals.
senses.exampleCN: 海边崖壁是坚实的 granite，布满深浅色晶体颗粒。
senses.why: Slow cooling gives crystals time to grow, and the visible speckle is the signature of that slow history.
senses.whyCN: 缓慢冷却给晶体生长的时间，肉眼可见的斑点正是这段缓慢历史的标志。

senses.title: The stone as a building material
senses.definition: the rock cut and polished for countertops, paving, walls, and monuments
senses.definitionCN: 被切割抛光用于台面、铺地、墙体与纪念碑的该种岩石
senses.example: The kitchen counter is polished granite.
senses.exampleCN: 厨房台面是抛光花岗岩。
senses.why: Hard, acid-resistant, and polishable, granite moved from cliffs into kitchens and bank lobbies.
senses.whyCN: 坚硬、耐酸且可抛光，使花岗岩从崖壁走进厨房与银行大厅。

senses.title: A large intrusive body
senses.definition: a batholith or stock of granite covering many square kilometres underground
senses.definitionCN: 覆盖地下许多平方公里的大型岩基或岩株
senses.example: The mountain range sits on a granite batholith.
senses.exampleCN: 这条山脉坐落在一处花岗岩岩基上。
senses.why: At depth, many granite intrusions merge into one enormous body that only erosion later reveals.
senses.whyCN: 在地下深处，许多花岗岩侵入体合并成一个巨大岩体，只有侵蚀才后来将其揭示。

senses.title: A tor or weathered upland
senses.definition: granite that weathering has shaped into tors, rounded boulders, and bare uplands
senses.definitionCN: 被风化塑造成岩丘、浑圆巨砾与裸露高地的花岗岩
senses.example: Granite tors crown the moor.
senses.exampleCN: 花岗岩岩丘耸立在荒原上。
senses.why: Granite fractures along joints and decays into rounded blocks, leaving towers where the rock was jointed least.
senses.whyCN: 花岗岩沿节理裂开并风化成浑圆石块，在节理最少处留下塔状岩丘。

senses.title: Monument and memorial stone
senses.definition: granite valued for monuments because it resists weather and takes a sharp edge
senses.definitionCN: 因耐风化且能磨出锋利边缘而用于纪念碑的花岗岩
senses.example: Names were cut deep into the granite obelisk.
senses.exampleCN: 名字被深深刻入花岗岩方尖碑。
senses.why: A memorial must outlast the memory it serves, and granite is chosen for exactly that durability.
senses.whyCN: 纪念碑必须比它所承载的记忆更长久，花岗岩正因这种耐久性被选中。

senses.title: Continental crust material
senses.definition: the granitic rock that makes up much of the continental crust, lighter than oceanic basalt
senses.definitionCN: 构成大陆地壳大部分的花岗质岩石，比大洋玄武岩轻
senses.example: Granite floats the continents higher than the ocean floor.
senses.exampleCN: 花岗岩使大陆浮得比洋底更高。
senses.why: Because it is less dense than basalt, continental crust rises and stands above the oceans.
senses.whyCN: 由于密度低于玄武岩，大陆地壳抬升并高出海面。

senses.title: A dimension stone trade name
senses.definition: any hard speckled stone sold under the commercial label granite, even when it is not true granite
senses.definitionCN: 商业上以花岗岩为标签销售的硬质斑点石材，即使并非真正花岗岩
senses.example: The showroom sells black granite that is really gabbro.
senses.exampleCN: 展厅卖的黑色花岗岩其实是辉长岩。
senses.why: Trade names follow appearance and durability rather than petrology, so the market's granite is wider than the geologist's.
senses.whyCN: 商品名依据外观与耐久性而非岩石学，因此市场上的花岗岩比地质学家的定义更宽。

senses.title: Abstract: unyielding hardness
senses.titleCN: 抽象义：坚硬不屈的性质
senses.definition: a quality of stubborn strength and resistance to change
senses.definitionCN: 固执坚强、抗拒改变的性质
senses.example: She met the criticism with granite calm.
senses.exampleCN: 她以花岗岩般的镇定面对批评。
senses.why: The metaphor takes the rock's most obvious property, hardness, and applies it to character.
senses.whyCN: 这一比喻取岩石最明显的属性——坚硬，并将其用于性格。

intro.en: Granite is an Italian coinage from the Latin word for grain, named for its visible crystals. The origin of the base word is well attested. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: granite 是意大利语造词，来自拉丁语「谷粒」，因肉眼可见的晶体而得名。词根书证充分。年代均为约数。

items.en: Latin granum meant 'grain, seed', from Proto-Indo-European gerh2- 'grain'. The root is widely attested in grain, granary, and granular.
items.cn: 拉丁语 granum 意为「谷粒、种子」，来自原始印欧语 gerh2-「谷粒」。该词根广见于 grain、granary 与 granular。

items.en: Italian stonecutters called the speckled rock granito, literally 'grained stone', from granire 'to produce grains'.
items.cn: 意大利石匠把这种带斑点的岩石称作 granito，字面是「有颗粒的石头」，来自 granire「使成粒」。

items.en: English adopted granite in the eighteenth century as the geological classification of rocks developed.
items.cn: 随着岩石地质分类的发展，英语在 18 世纪借入 granite。

items.en: Later petrology narrowed granite to a specific plutonic rock of quartz, alkali feldspar, and mica, excluding similar-looking stones.
items.cn: 后来的岩石学把 granite 收窄为一种由石英、碱性长石与云母组成的具体深成岩，排除外观相似的石材。

items.en: The building trade kept the older, looser sense, so commercial granite includes rocks that petrology would call something else. The exact date of this split is uncertain.
items.cn: 建筑行业保留了更早、更宽松的含义，因此商业花岗岩包括岩石学会另作定名的石材。这一分野的确切年代不确定。

note.en: Group one holds igneous rock names that are easily confused with granite; group two holds stones that look similar in use.
note.cn: 第一组是易与花岗岩混淆的火成岩名称；第二组是用途上外观相近的石材。

entries.definition: The adjective meaning 'of granite'; it describes the rock rather than naming it.
entries.definitionCN: 意为「花岗岩的」的形容词；它描述该岩石，而不是命名它。

entries.definition: To make into grains; it shares the Latin grain root but has nothing to do with igneous rock.
entries.definitionCN: 使成颗粒；与花岗岩共享拉丁语「谷粒」词根，但与火成岩无关。

entries.definition: A coarse-grained intrusive rock rich in dark minerals; commercial 'black granite' is often gabbro.
entries.definitionCN: 富含暗色矿物的粗粒侵入岩；商业上的「黑色花岗岩」常是辉长岩。

entries.definition: An intrusive rock between granite and gabbro in composition, with little quartz.
entries.definitionCN: 成分介于花岗岩与辉长岩之间的侵入岩，石英很少。

entries.definition: Recrystallized limestone used for carving and polish; it is softer and reacts with acid.
entries.definitionCN: 重结晶的石灰岩，用于雕刻与抛光；它更软且遇酸反应。

entries.definition: Metamorphosed sandstone, hard and granular but without feldspar's cleavage faces.
entries.definitionCN: 变质的砂岩，坚硬且具颗粒感，但没有长石的解理面。

entries.definition: A fine-grained volcanic rock, denser and darker than granite, forming the ocean floor.
entries.definitionCN: 细粒火山岩，比花岗岩更致密更深色，构成洋底。

entries.definition: A high-grade metamorphic rock with light and dark bands, often derived from granite.
entries.definitionCN: 具深浅条带的高级变质岩，常由花岗岩变质而来。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real Latin roots, real rock names and real collocations, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实拉丁词根、真实岩石名称与真实搭配，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: Granite is named for its grains: granum is Latin for grain.
normal.cn: 花岗岩因颗粒得名：granum 是拉丁语「谷粒」。

normal.en: Visible crystals mean slow cooling deep underground.
normal.cn: 可见晶体意味着在地下深处缓慢冷却。

normal.en: Its family runs granite, granitic, granular, granulate, grain.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 granite、granitic、granular、granulate 与 grain。

normal.en: Granite is continental; basalt is oceanic. Density explains the difference.
normal.cn: 花岗岩属大陆，玄武岩属大洋；密度解释了这一差别。

normal.en: Commercial granite is broader than geological granite.
normal.cn: 商业花岗岩比地质学定义的花岗岩更宽泛。

abstract.en: Picture a stone made of many tiny mirrors, each catching light at a different angle.
abstract.cn: 想象一块由许多小镜子组成的石头，每面镜子以不同角度反光。

abstract.en: Picture a cliff that refuses to soften even after a thousand winters.
abstract.cn: 想象一面崖壁，历经千个冬天仍不肯变软。

abstract.en: Picture a person whose calm looks carved rather than practised.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人的镇定像是被凿出来的，而不是练出来的。

examples.en: The sea cliff is solid granite speckled with dark and pale crystals.
examples.cn: 海边崖壁是坚实的花岗岩岩体，布满深浅色晶体颗粒。

examples.en: The counter is polished granite, cold even in summer.
examples.cn: 台面是抛光花岗岩，夏天摸着也是凉的。

examples.en: Weathering splits granite into rounded blocks that pile up as tors.
examples.cn: 风化把花岗岩裂成浑圆石块，堆成岩丘。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「格拉尼特」——布满彩色颗粒的硬石头 → 花岗岩

root: 意大利语 granito「有颗粒的石头」，源自 granire「使成粒」与 grano「谷粒」，再上溯拉丁语 granum「谷粒」，原始印欧语词根 gerh2-「谷粒」。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses run from the rock's cooling history to its uses, its landforms, its crustal role, its trade name, and finally to hardness as a human image.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从冷却历史走到用途、地貌、地壳角色、商品名，最后落到作为人性意象的坚硬。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a grey cliff surface speckled with black and white crystals, each large enough to see.
core.cn: 核心意象：布满黑白晶体的灰色崖面，每颗晶体都大到肉眼可见。

branches.en: CRYSTALS AND BODY: visible grains are the small signature of a very large slow-cooled mass.
branches.cn: 晶体与岩体：可见颗粒是巨大慢冷岩体的小小标志。

branches.en: DURABLE USE: hardness and polish make it a kitchen surface and a memorial stone.
branches.cn: 耐久用途：硬度与可抛光使它成为台面与纪念碑。

branches.en: LANDSCAPE: jointing and weathering turn the mass into tors and rounded boulders.
branches.cn: 地貌：节理与风化把岩体变成岩丘与浑圆巨砾。

branches.en: CRUST: low density keeps the continents standing above the ocean floor.
branches.cn: 地壳：低密度让大陆高出洋底。

branches.en: NAME AND METAPHOR: the market stretches the word, and the language borrows its hardness.
branches.cn: 名称与比喻：市场扩大了词义，语言则借用了它的坚硬。

intro.en: Granite's family is built on the Latin grain root, which is unusually productive in English.
intro.cn: 花岗岩的词族建立在拉丁语「谷粒」词根上，这一词根在英语中格外多产。

latinIntro.en: Latin granum and the Italian derivative granito stand behind granite; granum also gives grain, granary, and granular.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 granum 与意大利语派生词 granito 支撑 granite；granum 还给出 grain、granary 与 granular。

items.example: Granum is the source of several English grain words.
items.exampleCN: granum 是若干英语「颗粒」词的来源。

items.example: Italian masons named the rock granito.
items.exampleCN: 意大利石匠把这种岩石称作 granito。

items.example: Granite cools slowly and grows large crystals.
items.exampleCN: 花岗岩缓慢冷却，长出大晶体。

items.example: The granitic intrusion extends for many kilometres.
items.exampleCN: 这处花岗质侵入体延伸许多公里。

items.example: Granular texture is typical of slow cooling.
items.exampleCN: 颗粒状结构是缓慢冷却的典型特征。

items.example: The rock's grain size is easy to see.
items.exampleCN: 这块岩石的粒径很容易看清。

items.example: Granary and granite share the same Latin root.
items.exampleCN: granary 与 granite 共享同一拉丁词根。

items.structure: German Gneis, probably from a mining term
items.example: Gneiss often forms from granite under pressure.
items.exampleCN: 片麻岩常由花岗岩在压力下形成。

definition_en: money given for a purpose, or to give or allow something
core_image: 一张盖着印章的资助批文放在桌上
scene: 学校获得了一笔研究补助金。The school received a research grant.
sceneCN: 这里 grant 是「补助金、拨款」（第 1 个义项）；句意：学校获得了一笔研究补助金。

senses.title: Money for a purpose
senses.definition: money given by an organization for a purpose
senses.definitionCN: 机构为特定用途提供的款项
senses.example: The school received a research grant.
senses.exampleCN: 学校获得了一笔研究补助金。
senses.why: The noun sense is money formally given.
senses.whyCN: 名词义指正式拨给的钱。

senses.title: Give or allow
senses.definition: to give or allow something formally
senses.definitionCN: 正式给予或准许某事
senses.example: The court granted her permission to travel.
senses.exampleCN: 法院准许她出行。
senses.why: The verb sense is formal giving or permitting.
senses.whyCN: 动词义指正式的给予或允许。

senses.title: Admit as true
senses.definition: to admit that something is true
senses.definitionCN: 承认某事是真的
senses.example: I grant that the plan has risks.
senses.exampleCN: 我承认这个计划有风险。
senses.why: Admitting a point is a kind of giving way.
senses.whyCN: 承认一点，也是一种让步。

intro.cn: grant 来自古法语 creanter，意为同意或承诺。

items.cn: credens 意为相信、信任。

items.en: Creanter meant to promise or consent.

normal.en: She applied for a grant.
The city granted the permit.

normal.cn: 我们把干净的水视为理所当然。

abstract.en: A grant is trust written on paper.
abstract.cn: 补助金，是写在纸上的信任。

abstract.en: What is taken for granted is soon unseen.
abstract.cn: 被视为理所当然的，很快就会看不见。

abstract.en: To grant is to loosen your hold.
abstract.cn: 给予，就是松开你的手。

examples.en: The school received a research grant.

examples.en: The court granted her permission to travel.

examples.en: I grant that the plan has risks.
examples.cn: 我承认这个计划有风险。

sensesIntro.en: Grant means money given for a purpose, to give or permit, or to admit as true.

branches.en: A head nods at an opponent's point.
branches.cn: 一个人对对手的观点点头。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root is credere, to believe or trust.
latinIntro.cn: 其拉丁词根是 credere，意为相信、信任。

items.example: The fund grants money each year.

definition_en: a diagram that shows how numbers or amounts relate
core_image: 一条折线在方格纸上爬升
scene: 老师把成绩画成了一张图表。The teacher drew the results as a graph.
sceneCN: 这里 graph 是「图表」（第 1 个义项）；句意：老师把成绩画成了一张图表。

senses.definition: a diagram that shows how numbers or amounts relate
senses.definitionCN: 显示数字或数量关系的示意图
senses.example: The teacher drew the results as a graph.
senses.exampleCN: 老师把成绩画成了一张图表。

senses.whyCN: 泛指图表的义项是最日常的核心。

senses.title: A line over time
senses.definition: a line graph showing change over time
senses.definitionCN: 显示随时间变化的折线图

root: 来自希腊语 graphein（书写、描画），经法语 graphique 进入英语，核心义为「画出来的图」，后专指表示数量关系的图表。

sensesIntro.en: Graph means a general diagram, a line graph of change, or a shape in mathematics.
sensesIntro.cn: graph 指一般图表、显示变化的曲线图，或数学中的图形。

core.en: Numbers turned into a shape you can see.
core.cn: 数字变成看得见的形状。

branches.en: Bars rise from a ruled page.
branches.cn: 条形从横格纸上立起。

branches.en: A line climbs month after month.
branches.cn: 一条线逐月攀升。

branches.en: Points are joined into a clean shape.
branches.cn: 点被连成清晰的图形。

branches.en: A diagram and its rising line are one idea.
branches.cn: 图表与上升的线，是同一个想法。

branches.en: Change and shape share the same page.
branches.cn: 变化与形状，共用一页纸。

intro.en: Graph forms adjectives, nouns, and compounds.
intro.cn: graph 构成形容词、名词和复合词。

latinIntro.en: The Greek root graphein means to write.
latinIntro.cn: 其希腊词根 graphein 意为书写。

items.example: Draw a graph of the results.
The book gives a graphic account.
items.exampleCN: 这本书给出了生动的叙述。

items.example: The bar graph compares the years.
This line graph is easy to read.
items.exampleCN: 这张折线图很容易看懂。

definition_en: to take hold of something firmly, or to understand it
core_image: 一只手紧紧握住门把
scene: 他抓住绳子，爬上了岸。He grasped the rope and climbed ashore.
sceneCN: 这里 grasp 是「抓住」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他抓住绳子，爬上了岸。

senses.title: Hold firmly
senses.definition: to take hold of something firmly
senses.definitionCN: 紧紧地握住某物
senses.example: He grasped the rope and climbed ashore.
senses.exampleCN: 他抓住绳子，爬上了岸。
senses.why: The physical grip is the core sense.
senses.whyCN: 身体上的抓握，是这个词的核心。

senses.title: Understand
senses.definition: to understand something fully
senses.definitionCN: 完全理解某事
senses.example: She quickly grasped the main idea.
senses.exampleCN: 她很快领会了要点。
senses.why: The mind is pictured as taking hold of an idea.
senses.whyCN: 把心智领会概念比作用手抓住。

senses.title: Reach or understanding
senses.definition: the ability to reach or understand something
senses.definitionCN: 触及或理解某事的能力
senses.example: The task is within his grasp.
senses.exampleCN: 这项任务在他能力范围之内。
senses.why: The noun names the limit of hand and mind.
senses.whyCN: 名词义指手与心智所能触及的界限。

intro.en: Grasp appears in Middle English as a word for feeling with the hand.
intro.cn: grasp 在中古英语中出现，指用手摸索。

items.en: The word appears in Middle English as graspen.
items.cn: 这个词在中古英语中作 graspen。

items.en: Graspen meant to feel or grope for.
items.cn: graspen 意为摸索、探寻。

items.en: It narrowed to taking hold with the hand.
items.cn: 词义缩小为用手抓住。

items.en: The mental sense of understanding developed.
items.cn: 发展出「理解」的心理义。

items.en: The noun named reach and control.
items.cn: 名词义指触及范围与掌控。

note.en: Grasp is compared with look-alike words and words for holding.
note.cn: 把 grasp 与形近词以及表示抓握的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Grasp is the hand closing, then the mind opening.
normalIntro.cn: grasp 是手合上，然后心智打开。

normal.en: Grasp the handle tightly.
She grasped my hand.
I finally grasped the rule.
normal.cn: 我终于弄懂了这个规则。

normal.en: He grasped the chance to study.
Victory is within our grasp.
normal.cn: 胜利就在我们掌握之中。

abstract.en: Some things are held by the hand, some by the mind.
abstract.cn: 有些东西用手握，有些用心握。

abstract.en: A chance slips past an open hand.
abstract.cn: 机会会从张开的手边滑过。

abstract.en: To grasp is to make the distant near.
abstract.cn: 抓住，就是把远的拉近。

examples.en: He grasped the rope and climbed ashore.
examples.cn: 他抓住绳子，爬上了岸。

examples.en: She quickly grasped the main idea.
examples.cn: 她很快领会了要点。

examples.en: The task is within his grasp.
examples.cn: 这项任务在他能力范围之内。

dict_mnemonic.text: grasp 既是「抓住」，也是「领会」；grasp a chance 是抓住机会，within one's grasp 是力所能及；注意与 grass（草）、graph（图表）区分。

root: 中古英语 graspen 意为摸索、抓取，词源不详；核心义由手部的抓握扩展到心智的领会与能力的范围。

sensesIntro.en: Grasp means to hold firmly, to understand, or the reach of hand and mind.
sensesIntro.cn: grasp 指紧握、理解，或手与心智所能触及的范围。

core.en: The hand closes on something, then the mind does.
core.cn: 手先握住某物，接着心也握住。

branches.en: Fingers lock around a rope.
branches.cn: 手指扣住绳子。

branches.en: A rule clicks into place.
branches.cn: 一条规则忽然想通了。

branches.en: A goal sits just inside reach.
branches.cn: 目标就在伸手可及的范围内。

branches.en: Hand and mind use the same grip.
branches.cn: 手与心，用的是同一种握法。

branches.en: What is understood is also controlled.
branches.cn: 理解了的东西，也被掌握了。

intro.en: Grasp forms verb parts and adjectives.
intro.cn: grasp 构成动词变化和形容词。

latinIntro.en: Grasp has no Latin root; its origin is uncertain.
latinIntro.cn: grasp 没有拉丁词根，其词源不详。

items.example: She grasps the idea at once.
items.exampleCN: 她立刻就领会了这个想法。
那个贪婪的人想要更多。

items.example: The child is a quick grasper.
He looked at the gold graspingly.

items.exampleCN: 这个规模令人无法想象。

definition_en: feeling thankful for something
core_image: 一个人双手接过礼物，眼里带着谢意
scene: 她感激朋友在她困难时的帮助。She was grateful to her friend for the help.
sceneCN: 这里 grateful 是「感激的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她感激朋友在她困难时的帮助。

senses.title: Feeling thankful
senses.definition: feeling thankful for something received
senses.definitionCN: 因得到帮助而心怀感谢的
senses.example: She was grateful to her friend for the help.
senses.exampleCN: 她感激朋友在她困难时的帮助。
senses.why: Thankful feeling is the core modern sense.
senses.whyCN: 心怀感谢是现代最核心的用法。

senses.title: Expressing thanks
senses.definition: showing or expressing thanks
senses.definitionCN: 表达谢意的
senses.example: He sent a grateful letter.
senses.exampleCN: 他寄了一封感谢信。
senses.why: The feeling is turned into words and gifts.
senses.whyCN: 把感激之情化为文字与礼物。

senses.title: Pleasing
senses.definition: pleasant or welcome, in older use
senses.definitionCN: 旧用法中指令人愉快、受欢迎的
senses.example: The grateful shade saved us from the sun.
senses.exampleCN: 宜人的树荫让我们免于日晒。
senses.why: The oldest sense is simply pleasing.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义项就是「令人愉快的」。

intro.en: Grateful comes from Latin gratus, pleasing or thankful.
intro.cn: grateful 来自拉丁语 gratus，意为令人愉快的或感激的。

items.en: Gratus meant pleasing or thankful.
items.cn: gratus 意为令人愉快的或感激的。

items.en: Gratia meant grace, thanks, and favor.
items.cn: gratia 意为恩惠、感谢与好感。

items.en: Gratus grew the sense of feeling thanks.
items.cn: gratus 发展出心怀感谢之义。

items.en: Grateful entered English as thankful.
items.cn: grateful 以「感激的」之义进入英语。

items.en: It also kept the older sense of pleasing.
items.cn: 它也保留了较古老的「令人愉快」之义。

note.en: Grateful is compared with look-alike words and words for thanks.
note.cn: 把 grateful 与形近词以及表示感谢的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Grateful is the heart saying thank you.
normalIntro.cn: grateful 就是心里在说谢谢。

normal.en: I am grateful for your help.
She felt grateful to the doctor.
We are grateful for the rain.
He wrote a grateful note.
They were grateful to be safe.

abstract.en: Gratitude turns what we have into enough.
abstract.cn: 感激，让已有的变成足够。

abstract.en: A grateful heart keeps a light on.
abstract.cn: 感激的心，总留着一盏灯。

abstract.en: Small kindnesses are remembered longest.
abstract.cn: 微小的善意，记得最久。

examples.en: She was grateful to her friend for the help.
examples.cn: 她感激朋友在她困难时的帮助。

examples.en: He sent a grateful letter.
examples.cn: 他寄了一封感谢信。

examples.en: The grateful shade saved us from the sun.
examples.cn: 宜人的树荫让我们免于日晒。

dict_mnemonic.text: grateful 与 gratitude（感激）同根，词根意为「令人愉快的、感激的」；be grateful for 是对事感激，be grateful to 是对人感激；注意与 great（伟大的）区分。

root: 来自拉丁语 gratus（令人愉快的、感激的），经中古英语进入英语，核心义由「讨人喜欢的」转为「心怀感谢的」。

sensesIntro.en: Grateful means feeling thankful, expressing thanks, or, in older use, pleasing.
sensesIntro.cn: grateful 指心怀感激、表达谢意，或旧用法中的令人愉快。

core.en: A heart warmed by a received kindness.
core.cn: 因受惠而暖起来的心。

branches.en: A hand rests on the heart.
branches.cn: 一只手按在胸口。

branches.en: A short letter says more than it must.
branches.cn: 一封短信，说的比该说的多。

branches.en: Cool shade welcomes a tired walker.
branches.cn: 凉爽的树荫迎接疲惫的行人。

branches.en: Feeling and words belong together.
branches.cn: 心情与言语，本该成对。

branches.en: Thanks can be spoken or simply felt as comfort.
branches.cn: 谢意可以说出口，也可以化作舒适。

intro.en: Grateful forms comparison, adverbs, and nouns.
intro.cn: grateful 构成比较级、副词和名词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root is gratus, pleasing or thankful.
latinIntro.cn: 其拉丁词根是 gratus，意为令人愉快的或感激的。

items.example: I am grateful for your help.

items.exampleCN: 忘恩负义比拒绝更伤人。
这是个令人满意的结果。

definition_en: the force that pulls things to the earth, or seriousness
core_image: 苹果从枝头垂直落下
scene: 苹果受重力作用落向地面。An apple falls to the ground because of gravity.
sceneCN: 这里 gravity 是「重力、地心引力」（第 1 个义项）；句意：苹果受重力作用落向地面。

senses.title: The force of falling
senses.definition: the force that pulls objects towards the earth
senses.definitionCN: 把物体拉向地球的力
senses.example: An apple falls to the ground because of gravity.
senses.exampleCN: 苹果受重力作用落向地面。
senses.why: The physical force is the dominant modern sense.
senses.whyCN: 物理之力是现代最主要的义项。

senses.title: Seriousness
senses.definition: the seriousness of a situation
senses.definitionCN: 局势的严重程度
senses.example: He did not grasp the gravity of the situation.
senses.exampleCN: 他没有意识到局势的严重性。
senses.why: A heavy situation is felt as grave.
senses.whyCN: 沉重的事态被感受为严重。

senses.title: Dignified manner
senses.definition: a quiet and dignified manner
senses.definitionCN: 安静而庄重的举止
senses.example: She spoke with quiet gravity.
senses.exampleCN: 她带着平静的庄重说话。
senses.why: Weight becomes dignity in a person.
senses.whyCN: 重量在人的身上变成庄重。

intro.en: Gravity comes from Latin gravitas, weight and dignity.
intro.cn: gravity 来自拉丁语 gravitas，意为重量与庄重。

items.en: Gravis meant heavy.
items.cn: gravis 意为沉重的。

items.en: Gravitas meant weight and dignity.
items.cn: gravitas 意为重量与庄重。

items.en: Gravité carried the sense of seriousness.
items.cn: gravité 带有严肃之义。

items.en: Gravity named the force of falling.
items.cn: gravity 指使物体下落的力。

items.en: Newton's work fixed the physical sense.
items.cn: 牛顿的工作确立了它的物理义。

note.en: Gravity is compared with look-alike words and words for weight.
note.cn: 把 gravity 与形近词以及表示重量的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Gravity is the earth's long arm pulling everything down.
normalIntro.cn: gravity 就是地球伸出的长手，把一切都往下拉。

normal.en: Gravity pulls the ball down.
Astronauts float in zero gravity.
He understood the gravity of the news.
normal.cn: 他明白这消息有多严重。

normal.en: The centre of gravity is low.
She spoke with gravity.

abstract.en: Gravity is the quiet promise that things come down.
abstract.cn: 重力，是万物终将落下的安静承诺。

abstract.en: Some words have their own gravity.
abstract.cn: 有些话自带重力。

abstract.en: The heavier the truth, the softer the voice.
abstract.cn: 真相越重，声音越轻。

examples.en: An apple falls to the ground because of gravity.
examples.cn: 苹果受重力作用落向地面。

examples.en: He did not grasp the gravity of the situation.
examples.cn: 他没有意识到局势的严重性。

examples.en: She spoke with quiet gravity.
examples.cn: 她带着平静的庄重说话。

dict_mnemonic.text: gravity 与 grave（严重的）、gravely（严重地）同根，词根意为「沉重」；force of gravity 是重力，zero gravity 是失重，centre of gravity 是重心。

root: 来自拉丁语 gravitas（重量、庄重），词根 gravis 意为沉重，核心义由物理的重量扩展到事态的严重性与人的庄重。

sensesIntro.en: Gravity means the force of falling, the seriousness of a situation, or dignified manner.
sensesIntro.cn: gravity 指重力、局势的严重性，或庄重的举止。

core.en: Weight that pulls, whether of matter or meaning.
core.cn: 向下拉的重，无论是物还是意义。

branches.en: An apple drops straight down.
branches.cn: 苹果笔直落下。

branches.en: A report lies heavy on the table.
branches.cn: 一份报告沉甸甸地压在桌上。

branches.en: A person stands still and calm.
branches.cn: 一个人静立而沉稳。

branches.en: Physical weight becomes the weight of news.
branches.cn: 物理的重量，变成消息的重量。

branches.en: Serious matters make serious faces.
branches.cn: 严重的事，让人严肃。

intro.en: Gravity forms adjectives, verbs, and compounds.
intro.cn: gravity 构成形容词、动词和复合词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root is gravitas, weight.
latinIntro.cn: 其拉丁词根是 gravitas，意为重量。

items.example: People gravitate to the warm fire.
items.exampleCN: 人们被温暖的火吸引过去。
故事里想象了反重力靴。

definition_en: very much
core_image: 一株幼苗在几个月里长成大树
scene: 新技术大大提高了效率。The new technology greatly improved efficiency.
sceneCN: 这里 greatly 是「大大地」（第 1 个义项）；句意：新技术大大提高了效率。

senses.title: To a large degree
senses.definition: to a very large degree
senses.definitionCN: 达到很大的程度
senses.example: The new technology greatly improved efficiency.
senses.exampleCN: 新技术大大提高了效率。
senses.why: The main sense measures the size of an effect.
senses.whyCN: 主要义项衡量影响的程度。

senses.title: Very much indeed
senses.definition: very much, especially in formal thanks
senses.definitionCN: 非常，多用于正式感谢
senses.example: I would greatly appreciate your help.
senses.exampleCN: 我将非常感激你的帮助。
senses.why: The adverb softens and strengthens formal requests.
senses.whyCN: 这个副词让正式请求既礼貌又强烈。

senses.title: Widely in difference
senses.definition: to a large extent when comparing
senses.definitionCN: 在比较时表示差异很大
senses.example: Results vary greatly between regions.
senses.exampleCN: 各地结果差异很大。
senses.why: The same degree word measures difference.
senses.whyCN: 同一个程度词也可衡量差异。

intro.en: Greatly is great plus the adverb suffix -ly.
intro.cn: greatly 由 great 加副词后缀 -ly 构成。

items.en: Great meant thick or coarse.
items.cn: great 意为粗厚的。

items.en: Great grew to mean large.
items.cn: great 扩展为巨大的。

items.en: Greatly meant in a large degree.
items.cn: greatly 意为达到很大程度。

items.en: It became common with verbs of change.
items.cn: 它常与表示变化的动词连用。

items.en: It also softened formal requests.
items.cn: 它也用于缓和正式请求。

note.en: Greatly is compared with look-alike words and words for degree.
note.cn: 把 greatly 与形近词以及表示程度的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Greatly is the size of a change, spoken as an adverb.
normalIntro.cn: greatly 就是把变化的幅度说成副词。

normal.en: The weather greatly affects the harvest.
She greatly improved her writing.
I greatly appreciate your help.
Prices vary greatly by season.
The town has greatly changed.

abstract.en: A small cause can greatly change a life.
abstract.cn: 小小的原因，能大大改变一生。

abstract.en: What is greatly loved is greatly missed.
abstract.cn: 极爱之物，失之极痛。

abstract.en: The adverb measures the shadow of the verb.
abstract.cn: 副词丈量的，是动词的影子。

examples.en: The new technology greatly improved efficiency.
examples.cn: 新技术大大提高了效率。

examples.en: I would greatly appreciate your help.
examples.cn: 我将非常感激你的帮助。

examples.en: Results vary greatly between regions.
examples.cn: 各地结果差异很大。

dict_mnemonic.text: greatly 是 great 加 -ly 构成的副词，表示「大大地、非常」；greatly improve 是大为改善，greatly appreciate 是非常感激；注意与 grateful、gravely 区分。

root: 由 great（巨大的）加 -ly 构成，核心义为「以很大的程度」，常用于描述变化、影响与感激。

sensesIntro.en: Greatly means to a large degree, very much, or widely in comparison.
sensesIntro.cn: greatly 指达到很大程度、非常，或在比较中差异很大。

core.en: A large shadow cast by an action.
core.cn: 一个动作投下的大影子。

branches.en: A machine doubles its output.
branches.cn: 一台机器产量翻倍。

branches.en: A letter opens with warm thanks.
branches.cn: 一封信以温暖的感谢开头。

branches.en: Two maps show different climates.
branches.cn: 两张地图显示不同的气候。

branches.en: Big effects and big thanks share a word.
branches.cn: 大的影响与大的感谢，共用一个词。

branches.en: Degree lives in both feeling and fact.
branches.cn: 程度既在情感里，也在事实里。

intro.en: Greatly belongs to the great family of words.
intro.cn: greatly 属于 great 这个词族。

latinIntro.en: Greatly has no Latin root; great comes from Old English.
latinIntro.cn: greatly 没有拉丁词根；great 来自古英语。

items.example: The weather greatly affects the harvest.

items.exampleCN: 他的曾祖父建了这栋房子。
她的曾祖母活到了九十岁。

items.example: The old man held his great-grandson.

definition_en: a glass building for growing plants
core_image: 阳光透过玻璃屋顶照在番茄藤上
scene: 温室里的番茄长得很快。The tomatoes grow fast in the greenhouse.
sceneCN: 这里 greenhouse 是「温室」（第 1 个义项）；句意：温室里的番茄长得很快。

senses.title: A glass house for plants
senses.definition: a glass building used to grow plants
senses.definitionCN: 用来种植植物的玻璃建筑
senses.example: The tomatoes grow fast in the greenhouse.
senses.exampleCN: 温室里的番茄长得很快。
senses.why: The physical building is the core sense.
senses.whyCN: 实际建筑是这个词的核心义。

senses.title: A plant house
senses.definition: a heated house for flowers and tender plants
senses.definitionCN: 培育花卉与娇嫩植物的暖房
senses.example: Orchids fill the greenhouse in winter.
senses.exampleCN: 冬天，兰花摆满了花房。
senses.why: The building is named for what grows inside.
senses.whyCN: 建筑因其中生长的植物而得名。

senses.title: Trapping heat
senses.definition: used before nouns about trapped planetary heat
senses.definitionCN: 用于修饰行星热量被截留的相关名词
senses.example: We must cut greenhouse gas emissions.
senses.exampleCN: 我们必须减少温室气体排放。
senses.why: The glass house becomes an image for the planet.
senses.whyCN: 玻璃房成了整个星球的比喻。

intro.en: Greenhouse joins green with house for a plant building.
intro.cn: greenhouse 由 green 与 house 组合而成，指种植物之屋。

items.en: Grene meant green.
items.cn: grene 意为绿色的。

items.en: Hus meant house.
items.cn: hus 意为房屋。

items.en: Greenhouse named a glass house for plants.
items.cn: greenhouse 指种植物用的玻璃房。

items.en: The glass trapped heat like a garden shed.
items.cn: 玻璃像园中棚屋一样截留热量。

items.en: Greenhouse effect borrowed the image for the planet.
items.cn: 温室效应把这个意象借给了整个星球。

note.en: Greenhouse is compared with look-alike words and words for plant buildings.
note.cn: 把 greenhouse 与形近词以及表示植物房舍的词作比较。

entries.definition: a seller of fruit and vegetables

normalIntro.en: Greenhouse is a house that keeps spring inside.
normalIntro.cn: greenhouse 就是把春天关在里面的房子。

normal.en: The greenhouse is warm inside.
They grow roses in the greenhouse.
The greenhouse has a glass roof.
Greenhouse gases trap heat.
We visited the greenhouse at the garden.
normal.cn: 我们参观了花园里的温室。

abstract.en: A greenhouse keeps a season from leaving.
abstract.cn: 温室，把一个季节留住。

abstract.en: Glass lets light in and keeps warmth near.
abstract.cn: 玻璃放进光，把暖留住。

abstract.en: The planet is becoming a greenhouse of our making.
abstract.cn: 地球正在变成我们亲手造的温室。

examples.en: The tomatoes grow fast in the greenhouse.
examples.cn: 温室里的番茄长得很快。

examples.en: Orchids fill the greenhouse in winter.
examples.cn: 冬天，兰花摆满了花房。

examples.en: We must cut greenhouse gas emissions.
examples.cn: 我们必须减少温室气体排放。

dict_mnemonic.text: greenhouse 由 green 加 house 构成，指玻璃温室；greenhouse effect 是温室效应，greenhouse gas 是温室气体；近义词有 glasshouse、hothouse。

root: 由 green（绿色）与 house（房屋）复合而成，核心义为「种植植物的玻璃房」，后由玻璃截留热量的现象引申出温室效应。

sensesIntro.en: Greenhouse means a glass building for plants, a heated flower house, or, as an adjective, heat-trapping.
sensesIntro.cn: greenhouse 指种植植物的玻璃温室、花房，或作定语表示温室效应的。

core.en: A glass house where spring stays.
core.cn: 春天赖着不走的玻璃房。

branches.en: Sunlight fills a glass roof.
branches.cn: 阳光充满玻璃屋顶。

branches.en: Orchids bloom out of season.
branches.cn: 兰花在不当季时开放。

branches.en: A blue planet warms under a clear sky.
branches.cn: 晴朗天空下，蓝色星球在变暖。

branches.en: The building and its flowers share a name.
branches.cn: 建筑与花，共用一个名字。

branches.en: A small glass house becomes a global warning.
branches.cn: 小小的玻璃房，成了全球的警示。

intro.en: Greenhouse forms plurals and common compounds.
intro.cn: greenhouse 构成复数和常见复合词。

latinIntro.en: Greenhouse has no Latin root; both parts are Old English.
latinIntro.cn: greenhouse 没有拉丁词根，两部分都来自古英语。

items.example: The greenhouse effect warms the earth.

items.exampleCN: 他们卖温室栽培的番茄。

definition_zh: 问候；迎接；欢迎；对……作出反应
definition_en: to welcome someone with words or signs, or to meet something with a reaction
core_image: 跨过门槛的那一声招呼：人和事一到，反应立刻出门迎接
scene: 清晨的校门口，值日生站在门边挥着手。Every student was greeted with a warm hello.
sceneCN: 这里 greet 是「问候、迎接」（第 1 个义项：以言语或动作欢迎）；句意为每位学生都受到热情的问候。

pos.zh: 及物动词：问候；迎接；欢迎
及物动词：（事物）扑面而来；被……以某种方式回应

derivatives.zh: 由现在分词转化，义为「问候；问候语」
加施动者后缀，指迎宾员

senses.title: To welcome with words or signs
senses.definition: to say hello or make a friendly sign when meeting someone
senses.definitionCN: 见面时打招呼或作友好的示意
senses.example: She greeted each guest at the door.
senses.exampleCN: 她在门口迎接每一位客人。
senses.why: The core image is stepping toward the arriving person with a word ready.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是带着话迎向到来的人。

senses.title: To be received in a certain way
senses.definition: to be met with a particular reaction, often noise or silence
senses.definitionCN: 迎来某种反应，常是声音或沉默
senses.example: The news was greeted with cheers.
senses.exampleCN: 这消息迎来一片欢呼。
senses.why: The welcome sign also works for news and events.
senses.whyCN: 迎接的动作也适用于消息与事件。

senses.title: To come into one's senses first
senses.definition: to be the first thing seen, heard, or smelled on arrival
senses.definitionCN: 到达时最先被看见、听见或闻到
senses.example: The smell of coffee greeted us at the door.
senses.exampleCN: 门口先扑来咖啡的香味。
senses.why: Arriving things greet the senses like visitors.
senses.whyCN: 到来之物像访客一样问候感官。

senses.title: To react to with feeling
senses.definition: to show a feeling when facing something
senses.definitionCN: 面对某事物时表现出某种情绪
senses.example: The plan was greeted with doubt.
senses.exampleCN: 这个计划遭到质疑。
senses.why: Every reaction is a greeting of its own kind.
senses.whyCN: 每一种反应都是一场别样的迎接。

intro.en: Greet once meant to weep, then softened into welcome.
intro.cn: greet 一度意为落泪，后来软化为迎接。

items.en: Old English gretan meant to approach or address, and in Kent to weep.
items.cn: 古英语 gretan 意为接近、招呼，肯特方言中指落泪。

items.en: A Germanic verb family of approaching underlies the word.
items.cn: 词的基础是日耳曼语中表接近的动词族。

items.en: Middle English greten settled the welcome sense.
items.cn: 中古英语 greten 定下迎接义。

items.en: The senses of reception and reaction spread in modern use.
items.cn: 现代英语中回应与反应义扩展开来。

items.en: Modern usage greets news and feelings alike.
items.cn: 现代用法让 greet 兼迎消息与情绪。

note.en: Greet, welcome and meet overlap at the door.
note.cn: greet、welcome、meet 在门口交叠。

entries.definition: the act or word of greeting

entries.definitionCN: 大的；与 greet 仅差一字母
绿色；字形相近而词义无关

entries.definition: to receive gladly, often with offers

normalIntro.en: Five hooks to make greet a daily handshake.
normalIntro.cn: 五条钩子让 greet 成为每天的握手。

normal.en: Greet sounds like great: a great way to say hello.
normal.cn: greet 音似 great：打招呼的好方式。

normal.en: Greeting cards carry hellos through the post.
Guests are greeted before they sit.
News can be greeted with cheers or groans.
normal.cn: 消息可以迎来欢呼或叹气。

normal.en: Old English greet could mean weep: emotion at the door.
normal.cn: 古英语 greet 可指流泪：门口的情绪。

abstract.en: Greet is the first step across the doorstep.
abstract.cn: greet 是跨过门槛的第一步。

abstract.en: A raised hand travels faster than feet.
abstract.cn: 举起的手比脚更快。

abstract.en: Every morning greets you; greet it back.
abstract.cn: 每个清晨都在向你问好，请回应它。

examples.en: He greeted his teacher politely every morning.
examples.cn: 他每天早晨都礼貌地向老师问好。

examples.en: The team was greeted by cheering fans.
examples.cn: 球队受到了球迷的欢呼迎接。

examples.en: A cold wind greeted us as we opened the door.
examples.cn: 开门时一股冷风扑面而来。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「格里特」——客人一到就立刻迎接；greet 就是立刻迎上去的那声招呼

root: 古英语 gretan（接近、招呼），日耳曼动词族；肯特方言旧义为「流泪」，与拉丁语无亲缘。

sensesIntro.en: From hello at the door to reactions that arrive like visitors.
sensesIntro.cn: 义项从门口的招呼，扩展到如访客般到来的反应。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a word stepping out to meet what arrives
core.cn: 核心意象：迎着到来者跨出去的那句话

branches.en: the hello at the door
branches.cn: 门口的问候

branches.en: the reaction as reception
branches.cn: 作为迎接的回应

branches.en: what strikes the senses first
branches.cn: 最先抵达感官之物

branches.en: the feeling shown to a plan
branches.cn: 对计划的反应

branches.en: the two-way doorway
branches.cn: 双向的门

intro.en: Greet keeps a small, mostly native family.
intro.cn: greet 的词族不大，且以本族为主。

latinIntro.en: No Latin relatives; the verb stayed Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 没有拉丁同源词；动词保持日耳曼身份。

items.example: Old gretan even meant to weep in Kent.
items.exampleCN: 古英语 gretan 在肯特方言里竟指流泪。

items.example: He greets the dawn with a run.
The greeter stood by the door.
I bought a birthday greeting card.
They greeted the idea with laughter.
items.exampleCN: 他们以笑声回应这个想法。

definition_en: to crush something into small pieces or powder
core_image: 石磨缓缓转动，麦粒变成面粉
scene: 她把咖啡豆磨成细粉。She ground the coffee beans into powder.
sceneCN: 这里 grind 是「磨碎」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她把咖啡豆磨成细粉。

senses.title: Crush into powder
senses.definition: to crush something into small pieces or powder
senses.definitionCN: 把某物碾成小块或粉末
senses.example: She ground the coffee beans into powder.
senses.exampleCN: 她把咖啡豆磨成细粉。
senses.why: The physical crushing is the core sense.
senses.whyCN: 物理的碾磨是这个词的核心。

senses.title: Rub the teeth
senses.definition: to rub the upper and lower teeth together
senses.definitionCN: 上下牙齿相互摩擦
senses.example: He grinds his teeth at night.
senses.exampleCN: 他夜里磨牙。
senses.why: The same rubbing motion moves to the jaw.
senses.whyCN: 同样的摩擦动作转移到牙关。

senses.title: Work long and hard
senses.definition: to work slowly and steadily at something hard
senses.definitionCN: 缓慢而持续地做艰苦的事
senses.example: They grind away at the same task.
senses.exampleCN: 他们日复一日地苦干同一件事。
senses.why: Endless work is felt as a mill turning.
senses.whyCN: 无休止的工作，被感受为不停转动的磨。

intro.en: Grind is an Old English verb for crushing grain.
intro.cn: grind 是古英语动词，指把谷物磨碎。

items.en: Grindan meant to crush or grind.
items.cn: grindan 意为碾碎、磨碎。

items.en: Grind kept the mill and grain sense.
items.cn: grind 保留磨坊与谷物的含义。

items.en: It extended to teeth and to hard work.
items.cn: 词义扩展到磨牙与苦干。

items.en: Grind to a halt described a slow stop.
items.cn: grind to a halt 形容慢慢停下。

items.en: The daily grind named routine labor.
items.cn: the daily grind 指日常的苦差。

note.en: Grind is compared with look-alike words and words for crushing.
note.cn: 把 grind 与形近词以及表示碾碎的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Grind is stone against grain, day after day.
normalIntro.cn: grind 是石头对着谷物，日复一日。

normal.en: Grind the pepper finely.
The mill grinds wheat.
He grinds his teeth in sleep.
The machine ground to a halt.
She hates the daily grind.

abstract.en: The mill does not hurry, yet it finishes.
abstract.cn: 磨不着急，却总能磨完。

abstract.en: What is ground fine disappears into bread.
abstract.cn: 磨细的东西，消失在面包里。

abstract.en: Patience is a slow stone.
abstract.cn: 耐心，是一块转得慢的石头。

examples.en: She ground the coffee beans into powder.
examples.cn: 她把咖啡豆磨成细粉。

examples.en: He grinds his teeth at night.
examples.cn: 他夜里磨牙。

examples.en: They grind away at the same task.
examples.cn: 他们日复一日地苦干同一件事。

dict_mnemonic.text: grind 的过去式和过去分词都是 ground；grind coffee 是磨咖啡，grind one's teeth 是磨牙，the daily grind 是日常苦差，grind to a halt 是慢慢停下。

root: 来自古英语 grindan（碾碎），核心义为石头对谷物的研磨，后扩展到磨牙、机器停转与辛苦劳作。

sensesIntro.en: Grind means to crush into powder, to rub the teeth, or to work long and hard.
sensesIntro.cn: grind 指磨成粉末、磨牙，或长时间辛苦工作。

core.en: Stone pressing grain into dust.
core.cn: 石头把谷物压成粉。

branches.en: A millstone turns slowly.
branches.cn: 磨石缓缓转动。

branches.en: Jaws press together in sleep.
branches.cn: 睡梦中牙关紧咬。

branches.en: A worker repeats the same motion.
branches.cn: 工人重复着同一个动作。

branches.en: Grain and teeth meet the same friction.
branches.cn: 谷物与牙齿，承受同一种摩擦。

branches.en: Endless rubbing wears both stone and person.
branches.cn: 无尽的摩擦，磨石头也磨人。

intro.en: Grind forms irregular verb parts, agents, and compounds.
intro.cn: grind 构成不规则动词形式、施动名词和复合词。

latinIntro.en: Grind has no Latin root; it comes from Old English.
latinIntro.cn: grind 没有拉丁词根，它来自古英语。

items.example: He turned the grindstone by hand.

items.exampleCN: 他们重新打磨磨损的刀片。

definition_en: a firm hold, control over something, or a small clip for hair
core_image: 一只手紧紧握住冰冷的栏杆
scene: 她紧紧握住栏杆。She held the rail with a firm grip.
sceneCN: 这里 grip 是「紧握」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她紧紧握住栏杆。

senses.title: Firm hold
senses.definition: a strong hold with the hand
senses.definitionCN: 用手牢牢抓住
senses.example: She held the rail with a firm grip.
senses.exampleCN: 她紧紧握住栏杆。
senses.why: This is the basic physical sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最基本的物理义项。

senses.title: Control or understanding
senses.definition: power over something or a clear understanding of it
senses.definitionCN: 对某事的控制力或清晰理解
senses.example: The coach has a good grip on the team.
senses.exampleCN: 教练对球队掌控得很好。
senses.why: Holding became controlling in the mind.
senses.whyCN: 手中的「握住」延伸为心智上的「掌握」。

senses.title: Small clip
senses.definition: a small piece of metal or plastic that holds hair
senses.definitionCN: 夹住头发的小金属或塑料夹
senses.example: She fixed her hair with a grip.
senses.exampleCN: 她用发夹把头发夹好。
senses.why: The clip grips the hair, just as a hand grips.
senses.whyCN: 发夹「夹住」头发，正如手「握住」物体。

intro.en: Grip comes from Old English grippan, to seize, from a Germanic root.
intro.cn: grip 来自古英语 grippan（抓住），源于日耳曼语词根。

items.en: The root meant to seize or grasp.
items.cn: 该词根意为抓住、握取。

items.en: Grippan meant to seize with the hand.
items.cn: grippan 意为用手抓住。

items.en: Grippen kept the sense of a firm hold.
items.cn: grippen 保留了牢牢抓住的含义。

items.en: The noun named the hold itself.
items.cn: 名词义指握持本身。

items.en: The sense of mental control grew later.
items.cn: 「心智掌控」义后来发展出来。

note.en: Grip is compared with look-alike words and words for holding.
note.cn: 把 grip 与形近词以及表示握持的词作比较。

entries.definition: to keep something in your hand

normalIntro.en: Grip is the hand closing on something, and later the mind closing on an idea.
normalIntro.cn: grip 是手合拢抓住东西，后来也指头脑把握住一个想法。

normal.en: Grip the handle tightly.
He lost his grip and fell.
The story has a gripping plot.
normal.cn: 这个故事情节扣人心弦。

normal.en: She wears a hair grip.
The town is in the grip of winter.

abstract.en: What the hand holds, the mind can master.
abstract.cn: 手能握住的，心也能掌握。

abstract.en: A loose grip loses the rope.
abstract.cn: 手一松，绳子就滑走了。

abstract.en: Fear grips before it explains.
abstract.cn: 恐惧先抓住人，再去解释。

examples.en: She held the rail with a firm grip.
examples.cn: 她紧紧握住栏杆。

examples.en: The coach has a good grip on the team.
examples.cn: 教练对球队掌控得很好。

examples.en: She fixed her hair with a grip.
examples.cn: 她用发夹把头发夹好。

dict_mnemonic.text: grip 是「紧握、掌控」，也指「发夹」；get a grip 是控制住自己，in the grip of 是受……控制；过去式双写 p 变 gripped。

root: 来自古英语 grippan（抓住），源于日耳曼语词根；由手上的「握住」引申为对事物的掌控与理解。

sensesIntro.en: Grip means a firm hold, control or understanding, or a hair clip.
sensesIntro.cn: grip 指紧握、掌控与理解，或发夹。

core.en: The hand closing hard around something.
core.cn: 手用力合拢抓住某物。

branches.en: Fingers lock around a cold rail.
branches.cn: 手指扣住冰冷的栏杆。

branches.en: A coach reads the whole field.
branches.cn: 教练看清整个球场。

branches.en: A small clip holds a strand of hair.
branches.cn: 一枚小夹子夹住一缕头发。

branches.en: The hand and the mind both take hold.
branches.cn: 手与心，都能「抓住」。

branches.en: Tool and hand share the same action.
branches.cn: 工具与手，做的是同一个动作。

intro.en: Grip forms verb parts, agent nouns, and adjectives.
intro.cn: grip 构成动词变化、施动名词和形容词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，属于日耳曼语来源。

items.exampleCN: 那是一部扣人心弦的电影。

items.example: He added grip tape to the board.
items.exampleCN: 他在板子上贴了防滑胶带。

definition_zh: 食品杂货店；食品杂货；杂货业
definition_en: a shop that sells food, the food bought there, or the grocery trade
core_image: 货架上排满罐头、面粉和茶叶
scene: 她在街角杂货店买牛奶。She bought milk at the grocery.
sceneCN: 这里 grocery 是「食品杂货店」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她在街角杂货店买牛奶。

senses.title: Food shop
senses.definition: a shop that sells food and small household goods
senses.definitionCN: 出售食品和小型家用品的商店
senses.example: She bought milk at the grocery.
senses.exampleCN: 她在街角杂货店买牛奶。
senses.why: This is the common American sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是美式英语中常见的义项。

senses.title: Food bought
senses.definition: the food and goods bought at such a shop, usually plural
senses.definitionCN: 在此类商店买到的食品和杂货，常用复数
senses.example: The groceries are in the kitchen.
senses.exampleCN: 食品杂货放在厨房里。
senses.why: The shop name shifted to what it sells.
senses.whyCN: 店名转指店里出售的东西。

senses.title: The trade
senses.definition: the business of selling food goods
senses.definitionCN: 销售食品杂货的行业
senses.example: He has worked in grocery for years.
senses.exampleCN: 他在杂货业干了很多年。
senses.why: The abstract trade sense names the whole field.
senses.whyCN: 抽象的行业义指整个领域。

intro.en: Grocery comes from Old French grosserie, wholesale trade, from Medieval Latin grosseria.
intro.cn: grocery 来自古法语 grosserie（批发业），源头是中古拉丁语 grosseria。

items.en: Grossus meant large or coarse.
items.cn: grossus 意为大的、粗的。

items.en: Grosseria meant wholesale trade.
items.cn: grosseria 意为批发贸易。

items.en: Grosserie meant the grocer's trade.
items.cn: grosserie 意为杂货商的行当。

items.en: Grocery named the trade in bulk goods.
items.cn: grocery 指大宗货物贸易。

items.en: The sense narrowed to food shops and their goods.
items.cn: 词义收窄为食品店及其商品。

note.en: Grocery is compared with look-alike words and words for shops.
note.cn: 把 grocery 与形近词以及表示商店的词作比较。

entries.definition: a place where goods are sold

normalIntro.en: Grocery is the shop, the food from it, and the trade behind it.
normalIntro.cn: grocery 既指店铺，也指买回的食品，以及背后的行业。

normal.en: The grocery opens at eight.
I need to buy groceries.
Put the grocery bag on the table.
She wrote a grocery list.
He works in grocery.

abstract.en: A shop is also a list of needs.
abstract.cn: 一家店铺，也是一张需求清单。

abstract.en: Small goods hold a whole trade.
abstract.cn: 小小杂货，撑起一整个行业。

abstract.en: What we carry home names the place we bought it.
abstract.cn: 我们提回家的东西，成了那家店的名字。

examples.en: She bought milk at the grocery.
examples.cn: 她在街角杂货店买牛奶。

examples.en: The groceries are in the kitchen.
examples.cn: 食品杂货放在厨房里。

examples.en: He has worked in grocery for years.
examples.cn: 他在杂货业干了很多年。

dict_mnemonic.text: grocery 是「食品杂货店」，复数 groceries 指「食品杂货」；grocery store 是杂货店，grocery shopping 是采购食品；同根词 grocer 是杂货商。

root: 来自古法语 grosserie（批发业），源头是中古拉丁语 grosseria，再溯至拉丁语 grossus（大的、粗的）；由批发贸易收窄为食品杂货店及其商品。

sensesIntro.en: Grocery means a food shop, the food bought there, or the grocery trade.
sensesIntro.cn: grocery 指食品杂货店、买回的食品杂货，或杂货业。

core.en: Everyday food kept and sold in one place.
core.cn: 集中存放并出售的日常食品。

branches.en: Shelves line a small bright shop.
branches.cn: 货架排满明亮的小店。

branches.en: Bags of food wait on the counter.
branches.cn: 一袋袋食品放在柜台上。

branches.en: Trucks supply shops across a region.
branches.cn: 卡车为整个地区的店铺供货。

branches.en: The shop and its goods share one name.
branches.cn: 店铺与商品，共用一个名字。

branches.en: What is sold daily becomes an industry.
branches.cn: 每天出售的东西，汇成一个行业。

intro.en: Grocery forms plurals and compounds for shopping.
intro.cn: grocery 构成复数和与购物相关的复合词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin source is grosseria, wholesale trade.
latinIntro.cn: 其拉丁语源头是 grosseria，意为批发贸易。

items.meaning: a list of food to buy

latinEntries.exampleCN: 当时的批发贸易规模很大。
